Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: The parameter was changed successfully. E_ NOT_ OK: The parameter change was rejected. Description Request to change a specific transport protocol parameter (e.g. block size). Available via Fr Ar Tp.h
